cohort: Pregnant women admitted for delivery at the largest Covid-19 dedicated Shri Maharaja Gulab Singh (SMGS) maternity hospital
finding: Pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 had a higher rate of asymptomatic prevalence, lower mean gestational age, higher rates of medical comorbidity, C-section, preterm delivery, lower mean birth weight, lower Apgar scores, and higher rates of fetal distress compared to those who were negative.
mod_finding: The C-section rate was higher among SARS-CoV-2 positive women (58.3%) compared to negative women (29.8%).
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 37.5 ± 2.2 weeks for SARS-CoV-2 negative women and 36.6 ± 3.3 weeks for SARS-CoV-2 positive women
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: 2840 ± 450 grams for neonates of SARS-CoV-2 negative women and 2600 ± 600 grams for neonates of SARS-CoV-2 positive women
